name: Taishou x Alice: HEADS&TAILS
source: Fandisc of the Taishou x Alice series. Contains after-stories for the original characters and includes new routes for sub-characters Ookami and Ryoushi. Also featuring a school-parody story with routes for all the original characters.
translation: 《大正×对称爱丽丝》系列的粉丝碟。收录原作角色的后日谈，并为配角狼与猎人加入新路线。此外还包含一篇校园戏仿故事，原作所有角色均有对应路线。
